verdict: Leads up, cost per lead down — but no leads are entering the pipeline.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 90 leads from Meta at an average cost per lead of $23.66, and this past week that cost dropped 13.79% while spend held flat — a genuine efficiency gain, not a budget cut. However, none of those leads have moved into your intake pipeline: zero opportunities and zero appointments were created from 90 leads, which points to a breakdown in how leads are being followed up after they arrive. We're actively working to identify and close that intake gap so leads stop going cold. In the meantime, the final days of last week also showed a short-term dip in daily lead volume, which we're watching and addressing with a creative refresh to sustain momentum heading into the next period.
